story.iWant: comprehensive tests for the Silver IOManager
story.soThat: processed data persistence is verified and reliable
story.tasks:
- Task 1: Create test file structure (AC: 1) - Create tests/resources/test_silver_io_manager_unit.py - Set up basic test structure with fixtures (silver_io_manager with tmp_path) - Import necessary Dagster test utilities (OutputContext, InputContext, AssetKey) - Add pytest integration markers
- Task 2: Add extracted content tests (AC: 2, 4, 5, 6) - Test HTML content storage with full metadata - Test video (YouTube) content storage with full metadata - Verify full SHA256 hash generation (64 characters) - Verify created_at and updated_at timestamps (ISO 8601 format) - Verify lineage metadata structure (source_asset, source_hash, transformation_timestamp) - Test content round-trip (save → load → verify)
- Task 3: Add summary tests for success case (AC: 3, 4, 5, 6) - Test successful summary storage in JSON format - Test successful summary storage in markdown format (.md file) - Verify markdown content structure (title, URL, summary, metadata footer) - Verify full SHA256 hash used for both JSON and markdown files - Verify timestamps and lineage metadata
- Task 4: Add summary tests for failure case (AC: 3, 4, 5, 6) - Test failed summary storage in JSON format - Test failed summary storage in markdown format with error details - Verify markdown error format (title, URL, error, error_type) - Verify full hash and timestamps for failed summaries
- Task 5: Add error handling tests (AC: 7) - Test invalid content type (not "html" or "youtube") - Test missing required fields (url, type, status) - Test unknown asset_key in load_input - Test TypeError when list contains non-dict items - Test corrupted JSON during deserialization
- Task 6: Add load_input tests (AC: 2, 3) - Test loading extracted content from silver layer - Test loading summaries from silver layer - Test handling missing upstream output context - Test graceful handling of corrupted JSON files
- Task 7: Run full test suite and verify (AC: 8) - Run uv run pytest tests/resources/test_silver_io_manager_unit.py -v - Verify all tests pass - Ensure test markers (@pytest.mark.integration) are correctly applied
- Task 8: Run quality checks (AC: 8) - Run make check to verify format, lint, typecheck - Fix any ruff violations in test file - Ensure tests follow project conventions (no doc-strings per CLAUDE.md)

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: AC1: Unit test file created: tests/resources/test_silver_io_manager_unit.py AC2: Tests verify extracted content storage for HTML and video types AC3: Tests verify summary storage in JSON and markdown formats AC4: Tests verify full SHA256 hash filename generation (64-character length) AC5: Tests verify timestamp creation and updates (ISO 8601 format) AC6: Tests verify data lineage metadata preservation AC7: Tests verify error handling for invalid data AC8: All tests pass (pytest run succeeds for all SilverIOManager tests)

constraints.constraint: Integration tests only - no unit tests (per CLAUDE.md constitution)
No doc-strings in test functions (per CLAUDE.md)
Test file must mirror production structure: tests/resources/ mirrors dagster_project/resources/
Use @pytest.mark.integration decorator on all test functions
Use structlog, not print statements for any logging
Full SHA256 hash verification: assert len(hash) == 64
ISO 8601 timestamp validation: use datetime.fromisoformat() to verify format
All tests must pass before story completion
Run make check after implementation to verify format, lint, and typecheck

interface.name: SilverIOManager.handle_output
interface.signature: def handle_output(self, context: OutputContext, obj: Any) -> None

tests.standards: Tests use pytest framework with @pytest.mark.integration markers. Test files mirror production structure (tests/resources/ for dagster_project/resources/). Use tmp_path fixture for isolated file operations. Dagster test utilities required: OutputContext for testing handle_output(), InputContext for testing load_input(), AssetKey for asset identification. No doc-strings in tests. All tests must pass via 'uv run pytest'. Run 'make check' after changes for format/lint/typecheck verification.
